task.subject: A delegated-work queue health workflow for the githubnext/gh-aw-cao repository
task.intent: Assess whether a delegated-work queue health workflow is surfacing active stalled work, preserving bounded no-op decisions for completed or already-owned items, and attaining its intended value of moving actionable work items toward verified completion.
activationConditions: A repository operator enables a standalone delegated-work queue health workflow on githubnext/gh-aw-cao.
At least one delegated work item in githubnext/gh-aw-cao is observed with waiting or verification evidence within the dashboard horizon.
A workflow run for the delegated-work queue health workflow is observed in the selected horizon.
requiredEffects: For each eligible stalled or waiting work item opportunity, the workflow evaluates the current queue state and emits at most one bounded safe output requesting the next action.
Accepted repository evidence must remain limited to the producing workflow run, the work item evidence, and any linked outcome created for that same work item opportunity.
Completed, recently updated, or already-owned work items must remain without a new durable output when the workflow has no actionable intervention.
noopConditions: The work item is already verified complete or has an observed completed outcome state before evaluation.
The work item is actively owned with a recent next action and no waiting evidence that requires intervention.
A prior accepted workflow output already covers the same stalled work item opportunity in the selected horizon.
successConditions: The workflow activates for eligible stalled or waiting work item opportunities within the selected horizon.
Observed outcomes for eligible opportunities are accepted when intervention is needed or intentionally absent when no-op conditions hold.
Operational-value observations preserve the ordered metrics published by gh-aw for each workflow run.
uncertainties: A stalled work item does not by itself prove an accepted intervention was needed.
A successful workflow run does not by itself establish verified completion of the delegated work item.
A null operational-value metric must remain distinct from a numeric zero.

operationalValue.preservation: Preserve the metric identifier, native finite value or null, unit, and direction exactly as published by gh-aw.
operationalValue.opportunity: One stable delegated work item opportunity identified by work-item-id in githubnext/gh-aw-cao for the delegated-work queue health workflow.
acceptedEvidence: work-items rows scoped to the workflow and repository
outcomes rows linked to the same repository workflow and run provenance
operational-values rows published by gh-aw for the same workflow runs
maturationRules: Use gh-aw published maturity for each operational-value observation without redefining it in the dashboard.
Treat unmatured or unavailable evaluator evidence as missing rather than inferred attainment.
zeroRules: A numeric zero means the authoritative gh-aw evaluator reported zero attainment for that work item opportunity.
Do not substitute zero for null or missing evidence.
missingEvidenceRules: When no operational-value observation exists for an eligible workflow run, attainment remains missing.
When work-item evidence is unavailable or incomparable, do not infer opportunity completion or attainment.
